evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Instituting a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and to maintaining capability through practice (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic framing equates unrehearsed capability with non-possession, appealing to competence (mastery must be proven) and conservation (security must be tested).
Cadence label restates the recurring-practice value: stability through repetition (conservation) and skill maintenance (competence).

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating untested capability with absence of that capability, making rehearsal the proof of possession?
